boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: No-purchase campus activities for Loyola full-time undergraduates, plus free public events and spaces with verified access details.

cards.title: Take a swim at the FAC
cards.subtitle: Fitness & Aquatic Center
cards.notes: Bring your Loyola ID and check pool hours before heading over; full-time undergraduates are automatic FAC members.
cards.short_summary: Use the FAC pool for a no-purchase swim session.
cards.evidence_claim: Loyola says full-time undergraduate students are automatic Recreation and Wellness members with Loyola ID access, and the FAC includes an aquatics center.
cards.access_notes: For full-time Loyola undergraduates: automatic membership; show Loyola ID. Check pool-specific hours before visiting.

cards.title: Climb the FAC wall
cards.subtitle: Fitness & Aquatic Center
cards.notes: Check the climbing-wall schedule, bring your Loyola ID, and choose a route suited to your comfort level.
cards.short_summary: Try an indoor climbing session at the FAC.
cards.evidence_claim: Loyola lists a rock climbing wall at the FAC and says full-time undergraduate students are automatic members with Loyola ID access.
cards.access_notes: For full-time Loyola undergraduates: automatic membership; show Loyola ID. The wall has special hours.

cards.title: Walk or jog the indoor track
cards.subtitle: Fitness & Aquatic Center
cards.notes: Use the indoor jogging track for a low-key walk with a friend; check facility hours before leaving campus.
cards.short_summary: Get moving indoors on the FAC jogging track.
cards.evidence_claim: Loyola identifies a jogging track among the Fitness & Aquatic Center facilities and grants automatic member access to full-time undergraduates.
cards.access_notes: For full-time Loyola undergraduates: automatic membership; show Loyola ID and check facility hours.

cards.title: Set up a court game
cards.subtitle: Fitness & Aquatic Center
cards.notes: Meet at the FAC activity courts for a casual game; confirm open court time and bring your Loyola ID.
cards.short_summary: Use the FAC’s activity courts for an informal game.
cards.evidence_claim: Loyola lists activity courts at the FAC and states that full-time undergraduate students are automatic members with Loyola ID access.
cards.access_notes: For full-time Loyola undergraduates: automatic membership; show Loyola ID and check facility hours.

cards.title: Work out at the FAC
cards.subtitle: Fitness & Aquatic Center
cards.notes: Plan a workout in the FAC fitness center and check hours first, since schedules can change around breaks.
cards.short_summary: Use the campus fitness center without a separate purchase.
cards.evidence_claim: Loyola says the FAC includes a fitness center and that full-time undergraduate students are automatic members who access it with Loyola ID.
cards.access_notes: For full-time Loyola undergraduates: automatic membership; show Loyola ID and check facility hours.

cards.title: Browse the Julio Fine Arts Gallery
cards.subtitle: DeChiaro College Center, W131
cards.notes: Drop in during posted hours to see exhibitions and the permanent collection; verify holiday closures before going.
cards.short_summary: See campus art exhibitions and permanent-collection works.
cards.evidence_claim: Loyola states that all Julio Fine Arts Gallery events are free and open to the public, and lists regular gallery hours.
cards.access_notes: Free and open to the public. Posted hours vary by day; the gallery closes for Loyola holidays.

cards.title: Visit Evergreen Museum & Library
cards.subtitle: 4545 N. Charles Street, north of campus
cards.notes: Bring your Loyola ID and visit during the museum’s posted hours; the university lists student admission as free.
cards.short_summary: Explore a historic house museum and gardens near campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Loyola’s Family Weekend schedule states that Evergreen Museum & Library is free for Loyola students while visitors pay admission.
cards.access_notes: Free for Loyola students according to Loyola’s schedule; bring student ID and confirm museum hours before visiting.

cards.title: Cheer at a women’s volleyball game
cards.subtitle: Reitz Arena
cards.notes: Check the athletics schedule, then head to Reitz Arena to watch a home match; Loyola lists admission as free.
cards.short_summary: Attend a Greyhounds volleyball match at no admission cost.
cards.evidence_claim: Loyola’s Initium Week page states that admission to all home women’s volleyball games is free.
cards.access_notes: Loyola states admission to all home women’s volleyball games is free; confirm match date and start time.

cards.title: Join the Student Spirituality Panel
cards.subtitle: Loyola campus; September 16, 2026
cards.notes: RSVP for the September panel to hear student perspectives on religious diversity and connect over a respectful conversation.
cards.short_summary: A free campus discussion about religious diversity.
cards.evidence_claim: Loyola’s event listing labels the September 16, 2026 Student Spirituality Panel as a free event with a FREE RSVP option.
cards.access_notes: September 16, 2026, 5–6:30 p.m.; RSVP is listed as free. The location is shown after sign-in.

cards.title: Watch the Student Performance Showcase
cards.subtitle: McManus Theatre; Family Weekend 2026
cards.notes: Arrive early for the October 3 showcase in McManus Theatre; it is first come, first served and features student performing groups.
cards.short_summary: See a free live showcase by Loyola performing-arts groups.
cards.evidence_claim: Loyola’s Family Weekend schedule identifies the Student Performance Showcase as free and first come, first served.
cards.access_notes: Scheduled for October 3, 2026, 2–3 p.m. at McManus Theatre; free and first come, first served.
